title: Digital Forensics Analyst Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on operating systems, networks, file systems, evidence handling, forensic acquisition, malware analysis, incident response, investigative reporting and courtroom-ready documentation.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish programming, operating systems, networking and security fundamentals; Years 3–4 focus on forensic methodology, disk and memory analysis, mobile/cloud evidence, incident response and investigative reporting.

PhD routes

Move from individual evidence examination toward complex digital investigations and forensic programme leadership. Maintain rigorous evidence preservation and documentation while developing expertise in cloud, mobile, memory, identity, malware and AI-related evidence. Research into automated forensic analysis can complement, but should not replace, human validation of findings.
